answer.summary: Docker build fails in the front-end stage: `yarn build` (Vite/rolldown) reports 'Build failed with 7 errors' at line 1129. The individual error lines are cut out of the excerpt, so the exact cause isn't visible. A bundling failure is deterministic and would repeat on re-run, and the PR touches many front-end files (graph, nav, scenario/simulation tabs), so the errors are likely from this change. Check the 7 errors in the full log first.

evidence.quote: #35 ERROR: process "/bin/sh -c yarn build" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
